title: EM Imputation — EMimpute
text: function imputes missing responses using EM imputation (see Finch, 2008) <doi: 10.1111/j.1745-3984.2008.00062.x>. Amelia package (Honaker et al., 2011 <doi: 10.18637/jss.v045.i07>) used imputation. Integrated scores obtained rounding imputed values closest possible response value.

title: This main function imputes for missing responses using selected method — ImputeTestData
text: test.data Test data set (data frame matrix) containing missing responses. Missing values coded NA values (e.g., 8, 9). Mvalue Missing response indicators data (e.g. "NA", "8", "9", etc.). Mvalue="NA" default. max.score max possible response value test data. default max.score=1 (.e.,binary test data). max.score = 2 response categories (0, 1, 2), etc. Note: RF, lowest response value zero (.e., incorrect). method Missing response imputation methods.  "LW" (default) represents listwise deletes examinees reported missing responses (see De Ayala et al. 2001 <doi:10.1111/j.1745-3984.2001.tb01124.x>)  "" means treating missing responses incorrect (see Lord, 1974 <doi: 10.1111/j.1745-3984.1974.tb00996.x>; Mislevy & Wu, 1996 <doi: 10.1002/j.2333-8504.1996.tb01708.x>; Pohl et al., 2014 <doi: 10.1177/0013164413504926>).  "PM" imputes missing responses examinee /mean available items.  "IM" imputes missing responses item mean available responses.  "TW" imputes missing responses using two-way imputation (examinee response items, missing responses replaced item means first; see Sijtsma & van der Ark, 2003 <doi: 10.1207/s15327906mbr3804_4>). "RF" imputes missing responses using response function imputation (Sijtsma & van der Ark, 2003 <doi: 10.1207/s15327906mbr3804_4>).  "LR" imputes missing responses using logistic regression (binary responses) polytomous regression (polytmous responses) mice package (Van Buuren & Groothuis-Oudshoorn, 2011 <doi: 10.18637/jss.v045.i03>).  "PMM" imputes missing responses using predictive mean matching mice package (Van Buuren & Groothuis-Oudshoorn, 2011 <doi: 10.18637/jss.v045.i03>).  "EM" imputes missing responses using EM imputation Amelia package (Honaker et al., 2011 <doi: 10.18637/jss.v045.i07>). imputed values rounded closest possible response value. (see Finch, 2008 <doi: 10.1111/j.1745-3984.2008.00062.x>). round.decimal number digits decimal places imputed value. default value 0.
